concepts.quote: Do I need to change my program to read from a file?
concepts.why: The answer is only a question and makes no claim about what `<` or `>` do, so nothing can be levelled.

concepts.quote: Do I need to change my program to read from a file?
concepts.why: The student asks whether the program must change but asserts no rule or trace about data-driven code, so there is nothing to grade.
